title: Blackpink's Jisoo, Travis Kelce front Tommy Hilfiger Fall campaign
summary: K-pop megastar Jisoo of Blackpink and American football star Travis Kelce are among the pop culture personalities tapped by Tommy Hilfiger to headline its Fall 2026 campaign.
